repository.zh: 在 GitHub 上打开本插件

brandDesc.zh: 插件提供的品牌标识和配色色系风格。
brandDesc.en: The brand mark and its colour family: warm for Claude, blue for DeepSeek. While Colours follows the host, only the mark changes.

autoPopoverDesc.zh: 本插件提供的哪些弹层悬停时便展开。
autoPopoverDesc.en: Which popovers open on hover: the account popover alone, or also the permission, model, session-stats and home-page pickers.

composerDesc.en: Which input area the skin restyles: the new-conversation page, the conversation, or both. Off restores the host's composer.

homeDesc.en: The new-conversation page layout. Classic centers the hero and input card; Studio pins the composer to the bottom and shows usage.

modelDescriptionsDesc.zh: 一级列表的每个模型下面写一行说明，讲这个模型是什么。关闭后每一行只剩模型名。
modelDescriptionsDesc.en: A line under each model in the picker's first level saying what it is. Off leaves every row with the model's name alone.

peakrateDesc.zh: 给模型菜单的每一行标出此刻的峰价、谷价或限时活动，以及距离切换还有多久。关闭后各行只显示模型名。
peakrateDesc.en: Marks every row of the model menu with the peak, off-peak or promotional rate in force right now, and how long it lasts. Off leaves the rows bare.

quickDesc.zh: 在一级列表展示勾选的供应商。
quickDesc.en: Picked providers follow the official service in the picker's first level; one removed from the catalog stays marked "Removed" until unchecked.

usernameDesc.zh: 用户名会显示在欢迎语和账号行里。
usernameDesc.en: The name shown in the greeting and the account row; empty falls back to the signed-in account, then the launcher, then the system user.

brandNameDesc.zh: 替换侧栏顶部的品牌文字；留空时显示所选品牌自己的文字标志。
brandNameDesc.en: Replaces the brand text at the top of the sidebar. Leave empty to keep the chosen brand's own wordmark.

brandMarkDesc.zh: 替换侧栏顶部、折叠栏、新会话页与账号行兜底头像上的品牌标志。PNG、SVG 或 WebP，不超过 2 MB。
brandMarkDesc.en: Replaces the brand mark in the sidebar, the collapsed rail, the home page and the account row's fallback picture. PNG, SVG or WebP, up to 2 MB.

brandWordmarkDesc.zh: 替换标志旁的品牌名称，宽度按图片比例随高度换算，优先于品牌名称。PNG、SVG 或 WebP，不超过 2 MB。
brandWordmarkDesc.en: Replaces the brand name beside the mark, sized from the image's proportions, and wins over the brand name. PNG, SVG or WebP, up to 2 MB.

brandImageType.zh: 只接受 PNG、SVG 或 WebP 图片。
brandImageType.en: Only PNG, SVG or WebP images are accepted.

brandImageSize.en: The image is larger than 2 MB.

brandInkDesc.zh: 「原色」保留图片自己的颜色；「文字色」把图片当作形状，按所在位置的文字颜色上色，亮色暗色下都看得清。
brandInkDesc.en: Original keeps the images' own colours; Text colour fills each image with the text colour where it stands, legible in light and dark.

brandAccentDesc.zh: 按钮、选中标记、链接与焦点环使用的颜色；未指定时沿用所选品牌的强调色。配色选「跟随宿主」时不生效。
brandAccentDesc.en: The colour of buttons, selected marks, links and focus rings; unset keeps the brand's own. No effect while Colours follows the host.

motionDesc.zh: 请按需调整动画效果。动画会给设备带来渲染压力。
motionDesc.en: Adjust the animation as you need: animations put rendering pressure on the device.

paletteDesc.zh: 允许插件修改主题配色，关闭后只保留布局和控件。
paletteDesc.en: Claude uses the skin's own colours; Follow the host leaves colours to DSH or other theme plugins and keeps only layout and controls.

typefaceDesc.en: Claude uses the Anthropic faces (or the Inter and Noto Serif stand-ins) with JetBrains Mono for code; Follow the host keeps the fonts DSH sets.

mascotDesc.zh: 站在输入框上沿的像素小伙伴。
mascotDesc.en: The pixel companion on the input area's top edge, animated by the agent's state. Follow the brand picks the crab under Claude, Deepy under DeepSeek.

mascotScopeDesc.en: The new-conversation page alone, or the new-conversation page and the conversation.

searchStyleDesc.zh: 搜索框放在哪里：盖过品牌、品牌行下单独一行，或只保留宿主的搜索图标。
searchStyleDesc.en: Where the search box stands: over the brand, on a row of its own, or as the host's own search icon.

dockCardsDesc.zh: 把右侧栏停靠的面板画成悬浮卡片；关闭后铺满整列、贴住四边。
dockCardsDesc.en: Draws the right sidebar's docked panels as floating cards; Off fills the column edge to edge.

sidebarLayoutDesc.zh: 调整左侧栏的紧凑程度：「紧凑」收紧行高、间距与账号区内边距。
sidebarLayoutDesc.en: How tight the sidebar is: Relaxed is the default look; Compact trims row heights, gaps and padding.

chatUxManaged.zh: 该选项由插件 dsh-chat-ux 管理

windowsOnlyNote.zh: 只在 Windows 桌面端的窗口里生效。
windowsOnlyNote.en: Takes effect in the Windows desktop window only.

unavailable.zh: ERROR : 设置存储服务异常，改动不会被保存。
unavailable.en: The settings store is unavailable, so changes will not be saved.

remoteReadOnly.zh: 此页面经远程地址连接 DSH，DSH 只保存从 localhost 等本机地址打开的页面所做的改动。这里显示的是 DSH 当前的设置，请在运行 DSH 的电脑上修改。
remoteReadOnly.en: This page reaches DSH through a remote address, and DSH saves settings only from a page opened at a local address such as localhost. The values shown are the ones DSH holds; change them on the computer running DSH.

composerRequired.zh: 「重绘对话框」为「关闭」时不生效。
composerRequired.en: No effect while Composer restyle is Off.
